statement: The v0.0.80-frozen entropy-adjusted model-v3 token scores will prospectively predict broad C2 boundary-role membership in six entirely fresh genomes above a fixed-GC × wildcard-separation × entropy-bin conditioned null.
primary_statistic: M_v3 = sum frozen score_v3(t) over fresh boundary-role token memberships
movability_gate: >=50% of observed fresh boundary token×genome memberships movable
support_condition: If gate passes: observed>null mean and p<=.05; strong p<=.01.
weakening_condition: If gate passes: observed>null mean and p>.05.
contamination_boundary: Frozen before acquisition of all six fresh validation genomes.
